lines.en: Excuse me. My name is Richard Stewart.
lines.cn: 打扰一下，我叫理查德·斯图尔特。

lines.en: May I take a picture of you and your little boy?
lines.cn: 我可以给你和你儿子拍张照片吗？

lines.en: I call it Family Album, U.S.A.
lines.cn: 我打算把它命名为《走遍美国》。

lines.en: Well, it's fine if you take our picture.
lines.cn: 那行，你可以给我们拍照。

lines.en: Thank you. I appreciate your help.
lines.cn: 谢谢，非常感谢你的帮忙。
我是理查德。你叫什么名字？
请握住杰拉德的手。好极了！

lines.en: Give Mommy a kiss, Gerald. Nice!
lines.cn: 杰拉德，亲妈妈一下。真乖！

lines.en: We'll be looking for your book.
Hey, let me take your picture!
but I have some of the pictures.
Would you like to see them?
Here they are. Family Album, U.S.A.
It's an album of pictures of the United States:
lines.cn: 这是一本记录美国的摄影集：

lines.en: the cities, the special places, and the people.
lines.cn: 有城市、特色景点，还有形形色色的人。

lines.en: And these are pictures of people working:

炼钢工人、银行家、警察、街头小贩、

lines.en: Oh, this is my father. He's a doctor.
lines.cn: 哦，这是我父亲，他是医生。

lines.en: She works for a toy company.
lines.cn: 她在一家玩具公司工作。

lines.en: Here's my grandfather. He lives in Florida.
lines.cn: 这是我祖父，他住在佛罗里达。

lines.en: And this is my wife Marilyn.
Thanks. And what about your family?
That's a large city in northern Greece.
lines.cn: 那是希腊北部的一座大城市。

lines.en: But now I'm living in the Bronx.
lines.cn: 不过我现在住在布朗克斯。
和一个希腊裔美国家庭住在一起？

lines.en: I have to meet my wife.
It was a pleasure meeting you, too.
And good luck! I've got to go.

lines.cn: 顺便说一下，我是理查德。

lines.en: Bye-bye. Richard! Richard! You left your bag!
lines.cn: 再见。理查德！理查德！你的包忘了！

lines.en: how to get to Linden Street, in Riverdale?
lines.cn: 怎么去里弗代尔的林登街吗？
理查德·斯图尔特，林登街46号，

lines.en: You should take the number 1 subway.
Is there a station near here?
You should take the number 1 train
Number 1 train to Van Cortlandt Park. Thank you.
Remember, the number 1 train. The uptown platform.
lines.cn: 记住，1号线，上城方向的站台。

lines.en: Is this pink too bright for me?
lines.cn: 这件粉色的对我是不是太亮了？

lines.en: Mmm-hmm. It is a very bright pink.
How about green? It's size ten.
lines.cn: 那这件绿色的呢？是10码的。

lines.en: I'm taking too much of your time.
I was expecting him here at five forty-five.
lines.cn: 我本来指望他五点四十五到这儿。

lines.en: Don't worry. The traffic is very heavy at this hour.
lines.cn: 别担心，这个时间段堵车很厉害。

lines.en: I know. But we're going to be late for dinner.
lines.cn: 我知道，但晚饭我们真要迟到了。
我就买这件绿色毛衣吧。

lines.en: I like the color on me, don't you?
lines.cn: 我喜欢这颜色穿在我身上的效果，你觉得呢？

lines.en: I think it looks terrific on you.
lines.cn: 我觉得你穿这颜色棒极了。

lines.en: I had a really bad day.
It's ten after six. We're late.
lines.cn: 都六点十分了，我们迟到了。

lines.en: Robbie's cooking tonight, and dinner's at six thirty.
lines.cn: 今晚罗比做饭，六点半开饭。

lines.en: I know. I know. I'm really sorry.
lines.cn: 我知道，我知道，真的很抱歉。

lines.en: I left my bag of film on the ferry.
lines.cn: 我把装胶卷的包落在渡轮上了。

lines.en: I went back for it, but the ferry was gone.
lines.cn: 我回去找，可渡轮已经开走了。

lines.en: I lost a whole day's work.
lines.cn: 我一整天的工作成果都丢了。

lines.en: I'll call the Staten Island Ferry lost-and-found office.
lines.cn: 我打电话给斯塔滕岛渡轮失物招领处。

lines.en: I didn't think of that. Thanks.
of the Staten Island Ferry lost-and-found office.
lines.cn: 斯塔滕岛渡轮失物招领处的电话。

lines.en: Five five five...zero eight zero eight.

lines.cn: 玛丽莲，真是太谢谢你了。

lines.en: Did anyone find a camera bag this afternoon,
lines.cn: 今天下午有人捡到一个相机包吗，

lines.en: on the J. F. Kennedy Ferry?...No?
lines.cn: 在肯尼迪号渡轮上？……没有吗？

lines.en: The name is Stewart, Richard Stewart.
lines.cn: 我叫斯图尔特，理查德·斯图尔特。

lines.en: And the telephone number is five five five...
three oh nine oh. Thank you.
Sorry, Richard. They don't have it.
lines.cn: 抱歉，理查德，他们那儿没有。

lines.en: There was a girl on the ferry.
Tell me about it on the way home.
And give her a teaspoon of the medicine after every meal.
lines.cn: 每顿饭后给她吃一茶匙药。
对了，玛丽莲和理查德打过电话来。

lines.en: They'll be here soon, and then we'll eat.
lines.cn: 他们很快就到，到了我们就开饭。

lines.en: She has to work late tonight.
And what's Robbie cooking for dinner? Robbie
lines.cn: 罗比今晚做什么晚饭？罗比

lines.en: Robbie, the dinner was terrific. Robbie
lines.cn: 罗比，晚饭太好吃了。罗比

lines.en: We've got lots of ice cream.
Oh, I'd love some ice cream.
Well, there's chocolate and coffee and a little vanilla.
lines.cn: 有巧克力的、咖啡的，还有一点香草的。

lines.en: Is that all right with everyone?
and one scoop of chocolate for me.
Robbie, will you help me serve? Robbie
lines.cn: 罗比，帮我分一下好吗？罗比

lines.en: I keep thinking about that bag of film. Eight rolls.
lines.cn: 我老想着那包胶卷，八卷呢。

lines.en: Does Richard Stewart live here? Richard Stewart
lines.cn: 理查德·斯图尔特住这儿吗？理查德·斯图尔特
我是罗比……罗比·斯图尔特。
我是亚历山德拉·帕帕斯。

lines.en: Your brother left his bag of film on the ferryboat.
lines.cn: 你哥哥把装胶卷的包落在渡轮上了。

lines.en: I'm really glad to see you.
I mean...my brother'll be really glad to see you!
lines.cn: 我是说……我哥哥见到你会很高兴！
是理查德的胶卷！理查德
我是说，亚历山德拉·帕帕斯。
亚历山德拉！亚历山德拉

lines.en: Hello, Richard. I found your bag!
lines.cn: 你好，理查德，我找到你的包了！
呃……亚历山德拉，让我给你介绍一下。

lines.en: Richard showed me your photo. Richard
lines.cn: 理查德给我看过你的照片。理查德

lines.en: Richard told us all about you. Richard
lines.cn: 理查德跟我们讲了你的所有事。理查德

lines.en: And this is my mother, Ellen Stewart.
lines.cn: 这是我母亲，埃伦·斯图尔特。

lines.en: And my father, Dr. Philip Stewart.
lines.cn: 我父亲，菲利普·斯图尔特医生。
很高兴认识你，亚历山德拉。
还有……嗯……你已经见过罗比了。

lines.en: Yes. And you must be Susan. Hi.
lines.cn: 是的。那你一定是苏珊了。嗨。

lines.en: I'm so glad you found the bag
lines.cn: 你找到这个包，我真是太高兴了，

lines.en: and took the time and trouble to return it.
lines.cn: 还特意花时间费工夫送回来。

lines.en: I just took the wrong train.
Would you like something to eat?
I'm late for dinner at my house.
lines.cn: 我回家吃晚饭要迟到了。

lines.en: Would you like to call home?
lines.cn: 要不要往家里打个电话？

lines.en: Alexandra's a high-school exchange student from Greece. Alexandra
lines.cn: 亚历山德拉是从希腊来的高中交换学生。亚历山德拉

lines.en: With a family in the Bronx.
lines.cn: 和布朗克斯的一家人住在一起。

lines.en: Oh, that's not too far from here!
I can only stay a few minutes.
Where do you go to school?
At the Bronx High School of Science.
Oh, that's a very good school.
lines.cn: 哦，那可是所很好的学校。

lines.en: Richard tells me you're a doctor. Richard
lines.cn: 理查德说你是医生。理查德

lines.en: And what does your father do?

lines.cn: 他是律师，在塞萨洛尼基。

lines.en: It might be a little cold.
Thanks, no. I do have to go.
lines.cn: 谢谢，不用了。我真的得走了。

lines.en: It was nice meeting you all.
Well, maybe you'll come for lunch some Sunday,
lines.cn: 那也许哪个星期天你来吃午饭吧，

lines.en: so we can really thank you
The train is just up the street.
It won't take me long at all.
Well, you really saved the day for me, Alexandra.
lines.cn: 亚历山德拉，你可真是帮了我大忙。

lines.en: She's a smart young lady, and very nice.
lines.cn: 她是个聪明又可爱的姑娘。

lines.en: Very! Hey, she forgot her bag!
lines.cn: 太可爱了！嘿，她把自己的包忘了！

lines.en: I guess we'll be seeing Alexandra again.
lines.cn: 看来我们还会再见到亚历山德拉的。

lines.en: Excuse me. Can you help me?
That's easy. Walk to the corner.
Then walk two blocks to the traffic light.
lines.cn: 再走两个街区到红绿灯那儿。
再左转就到了伍斯特街。

lines.en: To the corner and then a left?
No. Thank you. I have a dinner date.
lines.cn: 不了，谢谢，我有个晚餐约会。

lines.en: Yes. Wooster Street is two blocks,
lines.cn: 伍斯特街往前走两个街区，

lines.en: and 83 is to the right, about two houses.
lines.cn: 83号在右边，大约第二、三栋房子。

lines.en: Hello, Harry. It's nice to meet you.
lines.cn: 你好，哈里，很高兴见到你。

lines.en: The traffic. The parking. I was lost.
Don't worry about being late. It's fine.
lines.cn: 别为迟到担心，没关系的。

lines.en: Excuse the mess. I just moved here.
lines.cn: 屋里有点乱别介意，我刚搬来。

lines.en: Oh, I'd like you to meet my sister-in-law Marilyn.
lines.cn: 哦，我想让你见见我嫂子玛丽莲。

lines.en: Marilyn Stewart, this is Harry Bennett.
lines.cn: 玛丽莲·斯图尔特，这位是哈里·贝内特。

lines.en: Are we too late for our dinner reservation?
lines.cn: 我们的晚餐订位还来得及吗？

lines.en: No, the restaurant will hold our table.
lines.cn: 没问题，餐厅会给我们留桌。

lines.en: I know the owner very well.
Do you know the phone number of the restaurant?
lines.cn: 你知道那家餐厅的电话吗？

lines.en: and leave the number with the baby-sitter.
Sure. The number is... five five five...seventeen twenty.
Five five five...one seven two oh. Hello?
I want to leave the phone number of the restaurant...
lines.cn: 我想把餐厅的电话号码留给她……

lines.en: Hi, Betty. I'll be at five five five...seventeen twenty.
Well, that's done. Shall we go?
I'm ready. See you later, Marilyn.
lines.cn: 我准备好了。回头见，玛丽莲。

lines.en: Bye, Marilyn. Hope to see you again.
lines.cn: 再见，玛丽莲，希望还能见到你。
啊！斯图尔特小姐！欢迎光临！

lines.en: This is my friend Harry Bennett.
lines.cn: 这位是我的朋友哈里·贝内特。

lines.cn: 斯图尔特小姐的朋友，在颂萨克餐厅都欢迎。

lines.en: I do, too. I come here often.
A special place for special people.
lines.cn: 特别的地方招待特别的人。

Yes, I'd like a glass of ginger ale with ice.

lines.en: Do you have a dry white wine?

lines.cn: 加州夏布利白葡萄酒怎么样？

lines.en: What would you like to eat?
Harry, would you like to see a menu?
I'll have the mee krob also.
Crispy fried noodles. I love them.
May I bring you a salad?
lines.cn: 要我给你们上份沙拉吗？

lines.en: What? Oh, yes. Starving. Well, I...
lines.cn: 什么？哦，是的，饿坏了。呃，我……

lines.cn: 你在环球玩具公司做什么工作？

lines.cn: 我是新玩具开发部门的副总裁。
我知道你是注册会计师。

lines.en: I do some work for Smith and Dale,

就是你们公司的那家会计师事务所。

lines.en: Do you have a picture of her?
And there's a phone call for you, Mr. Bennett.
lines.cn: 贝内特先生，有您的电话。

lines.en: I'll get the rest of the dinner.
I have to leave. I feel terrible, but...

lines.en: I don't know. The baby-sitter says she has a stomachache,

lines.en: Of course. I'm so sorry for Michelle.
lines.cn: 当然。我真替米歇尔担心。

lines.en: And you didn't have a chance to eat.
Let me take you home first.

lines.cn: 这是我们的第一次约会。

lines.en: I hope your daughter is all right. Good-bye.
I think she has a stomachache.
So... what do you think of him?
But I think he was nervous tonight.
lines.cn: 不过我觉得他今晚很紧张。

lines.en: It was his first date in two years.
lines.cn: 这是他两年来第一次约会。

lines.en: He didn't get a thing to eat.
You ordered enough for three or four people,
lines.cn: 你点得够三四个人吃的了，

lines.en: No. You won't believe it, Marilyn!
lines.cn: 不。你不会相信的，玛丽莲！

lines.en: I believe it. Even without looking.
Your downstairs neighbor let me in.
lines.cn: 你楼下的邻居让我进来的。

lines.en: I did , but everything is OK,
so I decided to come back.
To apologize for leaving so early,
I brought you a little gift.
Hi, Marilyn. I hope it's not too late.
lines.cn: 嗨，玛丽莲，希望我没来得太晚。

lines.en: Oh, not at all. We're still eating.
lines.cn: 哦，一点也不晚，我们还在吃呢。

lines.en: It's our meal from the restaurant.
lines.cn: 是我们从餐厅带回来的菜。

lines.en: It was only a tummy ache.
It's good that you went back.
Yes, I think it's important for me to be there
lines.cn: 是啊，我觉得我必须陪在她身边，

lines.en: As a matter of fact... I am hungry.
I have a lot of work to do to get ready for tomorrow.
lines.cn: 我还有很多工作要准备明天的活动。

lines.en: Good night, Harry. It was nice meeting you.
lines.cn: 晚安，哈里，很高兴认识你。

lines.en: She's going to a fashion show here in the city tomorrow.
lines.cn: 她明天要去市里参加一场时装秀。

lines.en: so she won't have to travel from Riverdale in the morning.
lines.cn: 这样早上就不用从里弗代尔赶过来了。

lines.en: The whole Stewart family is close.
lines.cn: 我们斯图尔特一家都很亲近。

lines.en: And then, two years ago, my wife died.
lines.cn: 然后，两年前，我妻子去世了。

lines.en: I do...yes, but I have Michelle...
lines.cn: 是的……我想她，但我还有米歇尔……

lines.en: Is there anyone else in your life?
lines.cn: 你生活里有其他的人吗？

lines.en: No, not yet. What about you?
but my work keeps me busy.
I have an early start tomorrow,
and the baby-sitter has to get home.

lines.cn: 我度过了一个愉快的夜晚。

lines.en: I'd like to meet your daughter someday.
lines.cn: 我希望哪天能见见你女儿。

lines.en: Does that mean that I can see you again?
lines.cn: 这是不是意味着我能再见到你？
太好了。我会给你打电话，

lines.en: and we'll go out to dinner.
I promise I won't leave early.
It was for a good reason.
I think we're going to be good friends.
lines.cn: 我觉得我们会成为好朋友。

lines.en: I never liked that umbrella stand.
lines.cn: 我一直不喜欢那个伞架。

lines.en: Marilyn, you want coffee or tea?
lines.cn: 玛丽莲，你喝咖啡还是茶？

lines.en: Grandpa will be sitting in the kitchen with us.
lines.cn: 爷爷就会和我们一起坐在厨房里了。

lines.en: Are we picking him up at the station?
He doesn't want anybody picking him up.
lines.cn: 他不想要任何人去接他。

lines.en: Oh, let's go upstairs and prepare Grandpa's room.
lines.cn: 哦，我们上楼去给爷爷收拾房间吧。

lines.en: We are going upstairs to set up Grandpa's room.
lines.cn: 我们正要上楼给爷爷布置房间。

lines.en: I'm really excited about seeing Grandpa.
lines.cn: 一想到要见到爷爷，我就特别兴奋。
我也是。请给我加点牛奶。

lines.en: I hope Grandpa's going to like living with us.
lines.cn: 我希望爷爷会喜欢和我们住在一起。

lines.en: It just takes time to feel comfortable in a new place.
lines.cn: 只是在一个新地方适应下来需要时间。

lines.en: Won't he miss being in Florida?
lines.cn: 他不会想念佛罗里达吗？

lines.en: But I think he'll like being here with the family.
lines.cn: 但我觉得他会喜欢和家人待在一起。

lines.en: It's crazy here most of the time.
lines.cn: 家里大多数时候都闹哄哄的。

lines.en: maybe I'll put together some photos of Grandpa
lines.cn: 也许我可以把爷爷的一些照片整理出来，

lines.en: I have a picture of Grandpa and Dad and me in my wallet.
lines.cn: 我钱包里有张爷爷、爸爸和我的合影。

lines.en: It's from the Fathers and Sons' Breakfast
at my junior high school graduation.
lines.cn: 那次“父子早餐会”上拍的。

lines.en: I'd really like to pick up Grandpa at the railroad station.
lines.cn: 我真的很想去火车站接爷爷。
不管是火车站还是机场。

lines.en: Grandpa always tells us he'll get here by himself.

lines.cn: 这些就是爷爷的全部家当吗？

lines.en: But I'm sure he has a few bags with him on the train.
lines.cn: 不过我敢肯定火车上他还带了几件行李。

lines.en: I want to put some of my good hangers in Grandpa's closet.
lines.cn: 我想把我的一些好衣架放到爷爷的衣柜里。

lines.en: You know I'm very excited about his arrival.
lines.cn: 你知道的，他一来我特别兴奋。
苏珊今天一大早就打来电话。

lines.en: because she's had to go to Chicago on a business trip
lines.cn: 因为她必须去芝加哥出差，

lines.en: She wants to be here for Grandpa.
Well, Grandpa will be disappointed, too.
She always reminds him of Grandma.
Fine. We were just wondering about this trunk.
lines.cn: 挺好的。我们刚才还在琢磨这个箱子。

lines.en: Oh. I have the key. Grandpa sent it to me.
lines.cn: 哦，我有钥匙，爷爷寄给我了。

lines.en: Excuse me. Is this seat taken?
lines.cn: 打扰一下，这个座位有人吗？

lines.en: Oh, let me help you with this.
Do you want to sit by the window?

lines.cn: 不不不，我更喜欢靠过道的座位。

lines.en: Please, you sit by the window.
My name is Stewart... Malcolm Stewart.
lines.cn: 我姓斯图尔特……马尔科姆·斯图尔特。

lines.en: I'm Elsa Tobin. How do you do?
Do you live in New York?
I am, too. But didn't you just get on?
lines.cn: 我也是。可你不是刚上车吗？

lines.en: No, no. I just changed my seat.
A man next to me was smoking,
Where are you from in Florida?

lines.cn: 泰特斯维尔，离奥兰多很近。

lines.en: Small world. I'm from Titusville, too.
lines.cn: 世界真小。我也是泰特斯维尔的。

lines.en: My husband and I live near Spaceport.
lines.cn: 我和我丈夫住在太空港附近。

lines.en: My house is only a few miles from Spaceport.
lines.cn: 我家离太空港只有几英里。

lines.en: Oh yes, yes. My husband's there now.
lines.cn: 哦，是的，是的。我丈夫现在还在那儿。

lines.en: He couldn't take time off to come to New York with me.
lines.cn: 他抽不出时间陪我来纽约。

lines.en: No. I sold the house and the furniture,
lines.cn: 不在了。我卖掉了房子和家具，

lines.en: put a few personal things in an old trunk,
lines.cn: 把一些私人物品装进一只旧箱子，

lines.en: and shipped it to my children in New York.
lines.cn: 托运给我在纽约的孩子们。
那儿就是我要去的地方。

lines.en: My wife died four years ago.
She was a wonderful woman. A real friend.
lines.cn: 她是个了不起的女人，真正的知心伴侣。
我很遗憾，真的替你难过。
我们留下了很多美好的回忆。

lines.en: We were married almost fifty years.
lines.cn: 我们结婚差不多五十年了。

lines.en: John and I celebrate our fortieth anniversary next month.
lines.cn: 下个月我和约翰要庆祝结婚四十周年。

lines.en: and works for Orlando Aircraft Corporation.
lines.cn: 在奥兰多飞机公司工作。

lines.en: He started with them almost forty years ago.
lines.cn: 他四十年前就进了那家公司。

lines.en: I just retired. Had my own company.
lines.cn: 我刚退休。以前有我自己的公司。

lines.en: A construction company. Roads, bridges, big stuff.
lines.cn: 建筑公司，修路、架桥，都是大工程。

lines.en: But I just sold it and retired.
lines.cn: 不过我刚把公司卖了，退休了。
打扰一下，女士，请出示车票。

lines.en: Would you kindly hold these keys, please?
lines.cn: 能麻烦你帮我拿一下这些钥匙吗？

lines.en: I have a ticket, I know.
I was in the smoking section.
It's OK, lady. Take your time.
I'm sure it's in your purse, Mrs.Tobin.
lines.cn: 托宾太太，我敢肯定票就在您包里。

lines.en: Do you have family in New York?
No, no. But I do have very close friends in New York City.
lines.cn: 没有，没有。不过我在纽约市有非常要好的朋友。

lines.en: We like to go to the theater together.
You said you have family in New York.
lines.cn: 你说过你在纽约有家人。

lines.en: A son and his wife and their three children-
lines.cn: 一个儿子，他妻子，还有他们的三个孩子——

lines.en: I can't wait, to see them!
lines.cn: 我迫不及待想见到他们！

lines.en: Are you going to live with them?
lines.cn: 你要和他们住在一起吗？

lines.en: but it's too early to know for sure.
I tried to teach my kids the importance of independence,
lines.cn: 我一直教孩子们独立的重要性，

lines.en: but I'm not sure I want to be alone.
lines.cn: 可我也不确定自己想一个人孤零零的。

lines.en: Some people don't mind being alone. I do.
lines.cn: 有些人不介意独处，我介意。

lines.en: I retired because... I wanted to be with my family.
lines.cn: 我退休是因为……我想和家人在一起。

lines.en: I didn't want to be alone anymore!
Amtrak is happy to announce our arrival in New York City.
lines.cn: 美铁很高兴地通知大家，列车即将抵达纽约市。

lines.cn: 列车将在五分钟后进站。

lines.en: Please check to be sure you have your belongings.
lines.cn: 请检查确认带好随身物品。

lines.en: And have a good stay in the Big Apple.
lines.cn: 祝大家在“大苹果”纽约过得愉快。

lines.en: It was so nice meeting you, Mr.Stewart.
lines.cn: 认识你真是太好了，斯图尔特先生。

lines.en: And nice meeting you, too, Mrs.Tobin.
lines.cn: 认识你我也很高兴，托宾太太。
电话簿里有我们的号码。
菲利普·斯图尔特医生，住在里弗代尔。

lines.en: That's right. And have a good time in New York.
lines.cn: 没错。祝你在纽约玩得开心。
还有，别那么逞强独立了。

罗比，我们很快就去钓鱼，

我们现在就把礼物送给他吧。

理查德，这些照片拍得太好了。

lines.cn: 这张真是勾起好多回忆。

lines.en: I sure do. It was fun.
Oh, I'm sorry Susan isn't here.

lines.en: I can't wait to see her.
She looks just like Grandma at that age.

我最好先去把行李收拾一下。

lines.cn: 我上路已经二十四小时了。

lines.en: Don't you want something to eat?
After a good night's sleep, I'll enjoy breakfast even more.
lines.cn: 好好睡一觉，明天早餐我会吃得更香。

lines.en: I'm sure glad you're here, Grandpa.

lines.en: I have the key, but it doesn't work.
I have something for you. I made it myself.
lines.cn: 我有样东西要送给你，是我亲手做的。

这是我们的家族谱系图。

lines.en: Why, I didn't know that your grandfather was born in Germany.
lines.cn: 哎呀，我都不知道你祖父是在德国出生的。

lines.en: Lots of interesting information about our family.
lines.cn: 里面有很多关于我们家族的趣事。

lines.en: Oh, Grandpa, I'm so happy to see you!
lines.cn: 哦，爷爷，见到你真是太高兴了！

lines.en: Oh, you look so beautiful, Susan. My granddaughter.
lines.cn: 哦，苏珊，你真漂亮，我的孙女。

lines.en: Like I always said, you look just like Grandma.
lines.cn: 我总说，你长得就像你奶奶。

lines.en: I think you're going to be very happy here with us.
lines.cn: 我想你在这儿和我们一起会过得很开心。

they give you a chance to rest between exercises.

lines.cn: 我每天早上举重六十分钟，

lines.en: doing aerobics for an hour is a lot different than lifting weights.
lines.cn: 跳一小时有氧操和举重可完全是两回事。

lines.en: I could work out in your class with no problem.
lines.cn: 我上你的课完全没问题。

lines.en: Tomorrow morning at ten o'clock. Try it.
lines.cn: 明天上午十点。你来试试。

lines.en: It's a nap. Tomorrow morning at ten o'clock.
lines.cn: 小菜一碟。明天上午十点。

lines.en: Aren't you going to the aerobics class this morning?
lines.cn: 你今天上午不去上有氧操课吗？
当然去。轻松得很，小意思。

lines.en: You are not going to be able to move
lines.cn: 上完这节课再加上有氧操，

lines.en: after this and the aerobics class.
lines.cn: 你到时候连动都动不了。

lines.en: It's going to be a piece of cake.
I bet I can go one hour in your class this morning
lines.cn: 我打赌我今天早上能上满你的一小时课，

lines.en: The bet is -- I win, and you cook dinner for the entire family.
lines.cn: 赌约就是——我赢了，你给全家人做晚饭。

lines.en: Or you win, and I cook dinner for the entire family.
lines.cn: 或者你赢了，我给全家人做晚饭。

lines.en: Ok. Call my instructor, Jack Davis, right now.
lines.cn: 好。现在就给我的教练杰克·戴维斯打电话。

lines.en: The advanced class starts at ten o'clock.
It only takes eight minutes by bicycle to the aerobics class.
lines.cn: 骑车到有氧操教室只要八分钟。

lines.en: Davis Aerobics Center for Good Health.
lines.cn: 戴维斯健康有氧操中心。
你好，我是理查德·斯图尔特。

lines.en: My wife, Marilyn Stewart, is a member of your program.
lines.cn: 我妻子玛丽莲·斯图尔特是你健身项目的会员。

lines.en: the ten o'clock advanced class this morning.
lines.cn: 今天上午十点的高级班。

lines.en: Oh, fine, fine. Be here a few minutes early.
lines.cn: 哦，好的，好的。提前几分钟到。

lines.en: You need to complete some forms before the class.
Thanks. I'm on my way over.
Bye-bye. It's all set. I'm going.
lines.cn: 再见。都安排好了，我走了。

lines.en: Your pressure is 120 over 75, and that's fine.
When was your last complete physical?
lines.cn: 你上次做全面体检是什么时候？

lines.en: Good. Do you have any back or knee problems?
lines.cn: 很好。你的背部或膝盖有什么问题吗？

lines.en: Nope. I am in perfect health.
What do you do for a living, Mr. Stewart?
lines.cn: 斯图尔特先生，你是做什么工作的？

lines.en: Everything. The American scene. People, places, events.
lines.cn: 什么都拍。美国的风土人情、人物、地点、事件。

lines.en: Did you ever think of photographing an aerobics class?
No...I can't remember taking pictures of people exercising.
lines.cn: 没有……我想不起来拍过人们锻炼的照片。

lines.en: But don't you think it'd be a good subject?
lines.cn: 但你不觉得这是个好题材吗？

lines.en: I need some good photos for my advertising, Mr. Stewart.
lines.cn: 斯图尔特先生，我的广告需要一些好照片。

lines.en: Maybe you can photogragh a class,
lines.cn: 也许你可以来拍一节课，

lines.en: and I can give you and Mrs.Stewart
lines.cn: 我就能送你和斯图尔特太太

Yeah. Yeah. Let's get in our lines.
We're going to take it slow first.
Stretch up...and we're going to go left first ...
Sunrises. Stretch it out. Flat back.
lines.cn: 旭日式。拉伸开。背部放平。

lines.en: Bring it up ... and twists ... and side ... 2, 3 ...
and left ... push ... push ... turn ... hit the floor.
Take it side again .... OK, and switch. Stretch it out.
lines.cn: 再向侧边……好，换边。拉伸开。

lines.en: And we're going to warm down with a tango.

lines.cn: 理查德，你今天去戴维斯有氧操中心上课了吗？

lines.en: Yes, I went to the aerobics class today.
lines.cn: 是的，我今天去上了有氧操课。

lines.en: Nothing. I am in excellent health.
I have ideal blood pressure. A perfect heart.
In other words, I'm in wonderful condition.
lines.cn: 换句话说，我的状态棒极了。

lines.en: Richard, did you go to the aerobics class, really?
lines.cn: 理查德，你真的去上有氧操课了吗？

lines.en: And don't forget to invite Susan for dinner.
lines.cn: 还有，别忘了邀请苏珊来吃晚饭。

lines.en: What about your arms? Lift your arms up like this.
lines.cn: 那你的胳膊呢？像我这样把胳膊抬起来。

lines.en: And they don't hurt ot even a little?
You are in great condition. I can't believe it!
lines.cn: 你的状态太好了。我简直不敢相信！

lines.en: Grandpa, Ellen, Philip, Robbie, you and me.
lines.cn: 爷爷、埃伦、菲利普、罗比，还有你和我。

lines.en: Cooking dinner for the entire family is not so easy.
lines.cn: 给全家人做晚饭可没那么容易。
西红柿、生菜、黄瓜和洋葱。

lines.en: The main course: steak and potatoes.
Richard, how much broccoli do I need for seven people?
lines.cn: 理查德，七个人吃需要多少西兰花？

lines.en: Marilyn, I have to tell you something.
lines.cn: 玛丽莲，我得告诉你一件事。

lines.cn: 我想锻炼来着，但杰克·戴维斯需要摄影师。

lines.en: I don't understand. Did you exercise or not?
lines.cn: 我不明白。你到底锻炼了没有？

lines.en: No. Instead of exercising, I photographed the class.
lines.cn: 没有。我没锻炼，而是给课堂拍了照。

lines.cn: 今天四点还有一节高级班。

lines.en: Oh, the bet is still on, but you shop for the groceries.
lines.cn: 哦，赌约照旧，不过采购食材由你负责。

lines.en: Remember, you win, and I cook dinner for the entire family.
lines.cn: 记住，你赢了，我给全家人做晚饭。

lines.en: You win, and I cook dinner for the entire family.
lines.cn: 你赢了，我给全家人做晚饭。

lines.en: Four o'clock at the advanced exercise class. With me.
lines.cn: 四点的高级健身课，跟我一起去。
扭转……再来……好，现在……剪刀步。

lines.en: This is fun. It's a piece of cake.
lines.cn: 这挺有意思的。小菜一碟。

lines.en: OK. Let's pick up the pace.
2, 3, 4, front. Now we're going to run it off.

All right. That's it for today.
Thank you, everyone. See you next week.
Thank you, Jack, but no thank you.

lines.cn: 高级健身课没那么容易吧？

lines.en: No, no, you were right. I was wrong.
lines.cn: 不不，你说得对，是我错了。

lines.en: Come on, Richard. Get up. Let's go.
You have to cook dinner for the entire family.
Marilyn, I'm exhausted. I can't move.
lines.cn: 玛丽莲，我累坏了，动不了了。

lines.en: Oh, you'll do it. It's a piece of cake.

lines.cn: 杰克，你真是个出色的教练。

lines.cn: 这是你第一次上高级有氧操课吗？

lines.cn: 理查德，你的身体素质非常好。

It's true. You are in great shape.
lines.cn: 真的。你的身体素质非常好。

lines.cn: 我想，我们还是一起做晚饭吧。

lines.cn: 我做得够一支军队吃了。

lines.cn: 这天气最适合了——有点多云，但晴朗温暖。

and my friends don't want to go.

lines.cn: 反正也不是什么重要的比赛。

lines.en: Do you have any other plans for the day?
lines.cn: 你今天还有别的安排吗？

lines.en: I have a new math program, and I want to learn how to use it.
lines.cn: 我有个新的数学软件，想学会怎么用。

lines.en: how to work on a computer someday.
Anytime. It's really easy, but, like anything,
lines.cn: 随时都行。其实很简单，不过和任何事一样，

lines.en: you need to work at it, Grandpa.
Oh, what are you doing tomorrow?

lines.cn: 那也许你爸爸和我可以带你去钓鱼。

lines.cn: 那明天你能跟我去钓鱼吗？

还记得我们第一次去钓鱼吗？

lines.en: Well, I've got to run, Dad.

lines.cn: 是他生日那天，两年前的六月二号。
还记得我们以前一起钓鱼吗？
还记得你钓到第一条鱼吗？

lines.en: I fell out of the boat!

lines.cn: 我们在一起有过很多美好的时光。

lines.en: Maybe we should do it again.
I want to spend more time with Robbie.
It'll be like old times for you and me.
Well, what's the weather going to be like?

lines.cn: 我只是尽一个爷爷的本分。

lines.en: First, we have to catch some fish.
In order to catch fish, you have to do this.
Then drop it into the water.
All of this comes before eating. OK?
lines.cn: 这些步骤都在吃鱼之前。明白吗？

lines.en: How do you know so much about fishing?
lines.cn: 你怎么懂这么多钓鱼的知识？

lines.en: We spent a lot of time fishing together.
lines.cn: 我们以前经常一起钓鱼。

lines.en: Now, the important thing is to get the hook close to the fish.
lines.cn: 现在，重要的是让鱼钩靠近鱼。

lines.en: I think I see some fish right under us, Dad.
lines.cn: 爸爸，我觉得咱们正下方就有鱼。

lines.cn: 好，罗比，也许你应该看着他点。

lines.en: I can go up to the lodge for some hot dogs and drinks.
lines.cn: 我可以去小木屋买些热狗和饮料。

lines.cn: 我们来这儿就是为了钓我们的午饭。

lines.en: know that I'm running for office
lines.cn: 不过我确实需要一些宣传，让镇上的人知道我在竞选，也知道我关心我们的孩子。

lines.en: and that I care about our children.
lines.cn: 不过我确实需要一些宣传，让镇上的人知道我在竞选，也知道我关心我们的孩子。

lines.en: I certainly can print the news.
lines.cn: 我当然可以刊出这则新闻。

lines.en: And you are now making news.
lines.cn: 而你现在就是在创造新闻。

lines.en: Grandpa: Here are the fliers, hot of the press!
Marilyn: Right over there, Grandpa. You fold the fliers, Richard and I will put them into the envelopes.
lines.cn: 我和 Richard 把它们放进信封。

lines.en: Richard: We finished addressing over three hundred envelopes.
lines.cn: 我们写了三百多个信封地址了。

lines.en: Mike: Hi, this is Mike Johnson. Can I speak with Mr. Or Mrs. Anderson? Thanks.
lines.cn: 我可以跟 Anderson 先生或太太说话？

lines.en: Robbie: Mr. Nelson. Hi. This is Robbie Stewart. Did you know my mother is running for the school board?
lines.cn: 你知道我妈妈在竞选学区教育委员会委员吗？

lines.en: Jimmy: Yes, Miss Kim, Ellen Stewart.”She cares.” Oh, see you at the polls.
lines.cn: 是的 Kim 小姐，是 Ellen Stewart。

lines.en: Robbie: Certainly, I’ll give her your best wishes, Mr. Nelson.
lines.cn: Nelson 先生，我会把你的祝福转达给她。

lines.en: Mike: Hi, this is Mike Johnson. Can I speak with Mr. or Mrs. Burns? Thank you.
lines.cn: 我可以跟 Burns 先生或太太通话吗？

lines.en: Ellen: We have done so much in such a short amount of time. I can’t believe it! Wait till Philip come and sees our progress!
lines.cn: 我们在这么短的时间里做了这么多事。

lines.en: Robbie: Everyone saw story in the Riverdale newspaper.
lines.cn: 每个人都已看到 Riverdale 报纸上的新闻。

lines.en: Ellen: Mr. Maxwell was very kind to print my announcement.
lines.cn: Maxwell 先生真好，刊登了我宣布参选的消息。

lines.en: Grandpa: It helps enormously. Everybody in Riverdale reads his paper.
lines.cn: Riverdale 的每个人都读他的报纸。

lines.en: Richard: Your photo in it helped, too.
lines.cn: 在报纸上的照片也有帮助。

lines.en: Ellen: Thanks to you, Richard, it’s a good picture.
lines.cn: 多亏了你，Richard，照片拍得很好。

lines.en: Philip: Well, hi, all. Richard&Robbi e Hi, Dad.
Philip: And I lick the envelopes.
Robbie: Hey, everybody, Mrs. Greenberg is on the phone. She says Carter Boswell is on the TV right now-doing a commercial.
lines.cn: 她说 Carter Boswell 正在电视上做广告。

lines.en: Boswell: …and if you ask what I care about, I’ll tell you. I care about the school buildings in need of paint. I care about more lockers for the teachers. I care about new fixtures in the hallways-not music or dancing or entertainment. I care about the practical things. If you do, vote for me, Carter Boswell.
lines.cn: 我关心走廊里的新灯具，而不是音乐、舞蹈或娱乐。

lines.en: Ellen: A lot of people will agree with him.
Robbie: Too bad kids can’t vote. It’s our school, but we can’t vote.
lines.cn: 那是我们的学校，可是我们却不能投票。

lines.en: Richard: There are people in favor of the cultural programs, Mom.
lines.cn: 会有许多人赞成文化活动的，妈妈。

lines.en: Marilyn: There are, Ellen. Don’t be upset by Boswell’s commercial.
lines.cn: 不要为了 Boswell 的广告而忧心。

lines.en: Philip: You have to go on television, too.

lines.cn: Boswell 是个有辩才的演讲家。

lines.en: Philip: You can be, too. Your ideas are good ones.
Ellen: I don’t know. I’m not sure I’m up to it.
lines.cn: 我不能肯定我是否能做得来。

lines.en: Ellen: …my slogan is”I care”. I care about people, not things, Vote for me, Ellen Stewart. I care. How was it?

Ellen: Hello. My name is Ellen Stewart, and I’m running for the open seat on the school board. My slogan is”I care”. What does the word care mean?…I care about people, not things. Vote for me, Ellen Stewart. I care.
lines.cn: 大家好，我叫 Ellen Stewart，正在竞选学区教育委员会空缺的席位。

lines.en: Philip: I like it, but now what? How can we possibly get it on so Riverdale will see it and hear it?
lines.cn: 我们怎么才能把它播出来，让 Riverdale 的人看见并听见呢？

lines.en: Ellen: …I mean that when I say”I care”. I care about people, not things. Vote for me, Ellen Stewart. I care.
lines.cn: ……我的意思是，当我说“我关心”时，我关心的是人，而不是东西。

lines.en: Richard: Mom is now on television in every appliance store in Riverdale, except Hamlin's. He's a Boswell voter.
lines.cn: 现在，Riverdale 每家电器商店的电视上都有妈妈，只有 Hamlin 的店除外。

lines.en: Philip: That’s a brilliant idea, Richard!
Grandpa: You inherited your father’s brains.
lines.cn: 你继承了你父亲的好头脑。

lines.en: Philip: We got our brains from you, Day.
lines.cn: 我们从你那儿继承了好头脑，爸爸。

lines.en: Richard: And guess what? I called channel five. Their TV news is going to cover it.”Housewife campaigns in appliance stores.”And I’ll bet some magazine will pick up the story, too.
lines.cn: 我敢说，也会有杂志报道这件事。

lines.en: Robbie: Mom, you’re going to win! I know it!
Philip: Hold it, Robbie! Just cool down. I know we’re getting some attention now, but in the end the voters will have to decide.
lines.cn: 我知道我们现在引起了一些关注，但最终还是要由选民决定。

lines.en: Grandpa: You’re going to win. Trust me!
Reporter: In the hotly contested race for the one seat on the Riverdale School Board, Mrs. Ellen Stewart has taken an early lead.
lines.cn: 在争夺 Riverdale 学区教育委员会一个席位的激烈选举中，Ellen Stewart 太太目前暂时领先。

lines.en: Robbie: She’s winning! Mom, you’re winning!
Reporter: Now returning to other local news…Riverdale High School beat its rival Horace Mann in baseball today…
lines.cn: Riverdale 高中在今天的棒球赛中击败了对手 Horace Mann……

lines.en: Ellen: It’s too soon to know for certain.
lines.cn: 现在还太早，不知道确切情况。

lines.en: Philip: You’re ahead. That’s better than being behind.

lines.cn: 广告后还有许多运动消息。

lines.en: Ellen: It’s not over yet. Let’s just all calm down, and wait for the final results.
lines.cn: 大家都冷静下来，等最终结果吧。

lines.en: Grandpa: Ellen, why don’t you go out to the backyard and get some fresh air?
lines.cn: Ellen，你何不到后院去呼吸一下新鲜空气？

lines.en: Ellen: Thank you, Grandpa. I need some.
Philip: You came very close, Ellen.
Grandpa: You lost by only a hundred and twenty-one votes.
lines.cn: 你只差一百二十一票就赢了。

lines.en: Marilyn: You lost by a very small number of votes.
Robbie: Only one hundred and twenty-one votes! I’m sorry, Mom.
Ellen: There just wasn’t enough time.
lines.cn: 实在是没有足够的时间。

lines.en: Philip: Look, you’ve made a very strong impressing on our community. You’ll have another chance next election.
lines.cn: 你给我们社区留下了非常深刻的印象。

lines.en: Philip: Hello. Oh, yes, yes, Mr. Maxwell.
lines.cn: 噢，是的，是的 Maxwell 先生。

lines.en: Maxwell: How are you? I just called to tell you that you are very impressive. You lost the election, but you won the attention of the residents of Riverdale, of Boswell, and of me.
lines.cn: 虽然你输了选举，却赢得了 Riverdale 居民、Boswell 和我的关注。

lines.en: Ellen: Well, thank you, Mr. Maxwell. I appreciate your kind words. I needed that.
lines.cn: 我很感谢你好心的安慰。

lines.en: Maxwell: I hear Boswell wants to appoint you to a special arts committee. I’m sending over a reporter in the morning to interview you.
lines.cn: 我听说 Boswell 想请你加入一个特别艺术委员会。

lines.en: Maxwell: I’m going to do an article on”Ellen Stewart-she cares.”Maybe we’ll all care now. Good-bye.
lines.cn: 我要写一篇关于“Ellen Stewart——她关心大家”的文章。

lines.en: Ellen: You were right, Philip. I did make a difference in town.
lines.cn: 我确实在镇上发挥了影响力。
也给这个家带来了改变。

lines.en: Richard: Are they always that difficult to make?
Philip: The truth is…yes. I’ll try again.
Robbie: At this rate, the wedding will take place tomorrow.
lines.cn: 照这个速度，婚礼得明天才能举行了。

lines.en: Philip: Not to worry. OK. Here we go.
Harry: I’m worried, Philip. What if we can’t tie the tie?
lines.cn: 如果我们打不好领结怎么办？

lines.en: Richard: If we can’t tie the tie, then there can’t be a wedding.
lines.cn: 如果打不好领结，那就没法举行婚礼了。

lines.en: Robbie: You’d better not make Harry any more nervous than he is. Don’t worry. We'll figure a way.
lines.cn: 你最好别让 Harry 更加紧张了。

lines.en: Harry: Not so good, Grandpa. We can’t get this bow tie tied. Nobody knows how to do it. Do you?
Grandpa: No. I never could, either.
Philip: Well, you have your own tuxedo. How do you tie your bow tie?
lines.cn: 可是，你有自己的晚礼服呀。

lines.en: Robbie: Yeah, Grandpa, I’ve seen you in it. You look great. How do you tie it?
lines.cn: 对呀，爷爷。 我曾见过你那身打扮。

lines.en: Grandpa: I never could tie one of those…things…bow ties. I have always worn a clip-on bow tie.
lines.cn: 我从来就不会打那一类的……玩意儿……领结。

lines.en: Philip: Of course. Now I remember.
Grandpa: Yes, it’s so easy. All you do is clip it around under your collar.
lines.cn: 你所要做的就是，将它夹在领子下方。

lines.en: Richard: We all need one of those.
lines.cn: 我们都需要一个这样的领结。

lines.en: Robbie: The tuxedo rental store. Do you think they’re open?
Philip: Should be. Sunday’s their big day.
lines.cn: 应该是开的。 星期天是他们大生意的日子。

lines.en: Richard: I’ll call and find out.
Grandpa: Well, if they’re not, I’ll lend you mine, Harry. You’re the only one who really needs to be wearing a tuxedo, anyway.
lines.cn: 反正你才是我们当中唯一真正需要穿晚礼服的人。

lines.en: Philip: I’m the father of the bride. I’m supposed to be worried about my daughter, and here I am with the man that’s marrying my daughter-worrying about him.
lines.cn: 我本来应该为女儿担心，结果却在这里，为这个即将娶我女儿的人操心。

lines.en: Grandpa: Poor Harry. I know the feeling. Wedding-day litters.
lines.cn: 可怜的 Harry。 我知道这种感觉。

lines.en: Richard: We’re in luck. They’re open. And they have lots of clip-on bow ties.
lines.cn: 而且他们有许多夹上去的领结。

lines.en: Robbie: I’ll bicycle down to the village and get them.
Grandpa: There’s lots of time. A little over two hours.
lines.cn: 时间多得很。两个钟头多一点。

lines.en: Harry: In two hours and fifteen minutes I’ll be married to Susan.
lines.cn: 再过两小时十五分钟，我就要和 Susan 结婚了。

lines.en: Philip: And be a true member of the Stewart family.
lines.cn: 也真正成了 Stewart 家庭中的一员。

lines.en: Grandpa: Oh, you’re a lucky guy, Harry. Susan is one of the best women you’ll ever find. She’s just like her grandma.
lines.cn: Susan 是你能找到最好的女人之一。

lines.en: Richard: Now, once you put the ring on Susan’s finger, you are one of us, Harry. And don’t ever forget it.
lines.cn: Harry，一旦你把戒指戴到 Susan 手上，你就是我们家的一员了。

lines.en: Harry: Ring? Ring? Oh my! What did I do with the rings? I put them in the pocket of my sports jacket.
lines.cn: 戒指，戒指，噢，我的天，我把戒指放哪儿了？

lines.en: Richard: No, I think you put them in your tuxedo jacket pocket. Remember?
lines.cn: 不对，我想你把它们放在晚礼服上衣的口袋里了。

lines.en: Harry: Right. What did I do with the rings?
Philip: Didn’t you give them to Richard? He’s your best man. I remember. You gave them to Richard.
lines.cn: 我记起来了。 你交给了 Richard。

lines.en: Richard: Oh, yeah. I remember now. You handed them to me. What did I do with them?
Harry: I hope they aren’t lost.
Grandpa: Oh, don’t worry, Harry. They have to be here.
Richard: I remember. I gave them to Robbie to hold so I wouldn’t lose them.
lines.cn: 我想起来了，我交给 Robbie 拿着，免得自己弄丢。

lines.en: Harry: Oh, I forget. What time is it?
Grandpa: It’s still a little over two hours, Harry. Just relax.
lines.cn: 仍然还有两个多小时 Harry 不用紧张。

lines.en: Richard: I’m sure Robbie has them.

Harry: No, NO, Robbie doesn’t have them. He gave them to me to hold on to them because he didn’t want the responsibility of holding them. I put them in my tuxedo but in the lapel pocket. That’s a relent. I was really worried.
lines.cn: 他把戒指交还给我保管，因为他不想承担保管戒指的责任。

lines.en: Richard: I’ll hold on to them for you. The best man always keeps the rings.
Harry: You’re right. You’re right. You hold on to them so there won’t be problem later.
lines.cn: 你来保管，免得等一下又出问题了。

lines.en: Philip: Well, now, I think we’d better get dressed, fellas.
lines.cn: 好了，现在我们最好去穿好衣服，各位。

lines.en: Richard: Robbie will bring the ties back.

lines.cn: 你不会有事的。 放轻松点。

lines.en: Philip: Try to take it easy. It’ll all be over in two hours.
Grandpa: The wedding ceremony will be over. You’ll be husband and wife.
lines.cn: 婚礼会结束。你们就成为夫妻了。

lines.en: Harry: I guess you’re right. Two hours from now. Two hours from now.
lines.cn: 说的也对。 从现在起还有两个小时。

lines.en: Marilyn: And now for…something old, something new, something borrowed, and something blue.
lines.cn: 现在轮到……一件旧的、一件新的、一件借来的，还有一件蓝色的东西。

lines.en: Susan: OK. Let’s see. Something borrowed. That’s this dress. Borrowed from Marilyn.
lines.cn: 就是这件礼服，向 Marilyn 借的。

lines.en: Ellen: Something blue. My wristband. I wore it when I married your father.
lines.cn: 我和你父亲结婚时戴着它。

lines.en: Susan: Oh, Mother. I forgot you still had it. It’s just so lovely.
lines.cn: 噢，妈妈。我忘了你仍然保留着它。

lines.en: Ellen: I bought it in an antique shop when I was about eighteen years old. I saved it for my wedding day.
lines.cn: 我十八岁左右时，在一家古董店买了它。

lines.en: Susan: And you saved it for me, didn’t you, Mother?
lines.cn: 也留着要给我，对吗，妈妈？

lines.en: Ellen: Yes, honey I did. Are we ever going to finish?
Ellen: All right. OK. Something borrowed.
Marilyn: The wedding dress. And something blue.
Ellen: Something old. Right. What’s old?
Susan: Of course! Something old. I had planned to wear them.
Ellen: Grandma’s pearls! Oh, Grandpa will be so pleased that you’re wearing them. I’m sure he misses Grandma on a day like this.
lines.cn: 噢，戴了它，祖父一定会非常高兴。

lines.en: Susan: Help me with them, Marilyn. I’ve never worn them before. I’ve been saving them for today.
lines.cn: 我一直留着等今天才戴。

lines.en: Ellen: Saving them for today? Oh, you’re a real Stewart!
lines.cn: 哦，你真是个地道的 Stewart 家人！

lines.en: Marilyn: Oh, there you go. Lovely!
Marilyn: Something borrowed, something blue. Something old… and now for something new.
lines.cn: 旧的东西……现在该看新的东西了。

lines.en: Susan: The veil. Oh, it’s so beautiful, Marilyn!
Ellen: You really are a fabulous designer, Marilyn.
lines.cn: Marilyn，你真是个出色的设计师。

lines.en: Marilyn: Doesn’t it look just right on Susan?
lines.cn: Susan 戴起来正好，不是吗？

lines.en: Marilyn: And when you both say, “I do,” Harry will lift this veil over your head and kiss the bride.
lines.cn: 当你们两人都说“我愿意”时，Harry 就会掀起你的头纱，亲吻新娘。

lines.en: Susan: When you said, “I do, ” Marilyn, it suddenly became real.
lines.cn: Marilyn，你刚说“我愿意”的时候，这一切突然变得真实了。

lines.en: Marilyn: That’s all right, Susan. You’ve got the wedding-day jitters! In less than two hours, you will be Mrs. Harry Bennett.
lines.cn: 再过不到两个小时，你就成为 Harry Bennett 太太了。

lines.en: Ellen: Oh, that reminds me. If we don’t get dressed, we won’t be there to see Susan become Mrs. Harry Bennett.
lines.cn: 如果我们还不去换衣服，就赶不上看 Susan 成为 Harry Bennett 太太了。

lines.en: Susan: Before you leave-do I look all right?
lines.cn: 在你们离开之前，告诉我，我这样子可以吗？

lines.en: Marilyn: She’s right. And that’s dear little Max. Got to go and feed him.
Susan: What am I Supposed to do?
Marilyn: Take off the veil, kick off your shoes, and sit down.
lines.cn: 摘下头纱，脱掉鞋子，坐下来。

lines.en: Ellen: We’ll come upstairs and get you in a little while.
lines.cn: 我们待会儿就上楼来带你下去。

lines.en: Marilyn: Richard’s going to take some wedding pictures before the ceremony. So just relax.
lines.cn: Richard 会在仪式开始前拍些婚礼照片。

lines.en: Susan: Susan Stewart…you are about to become Susan Bennett-Mrs. Harry Bennett.
lines.cn: Susan Stewart……你就要成为 Susan Bennett，也就是 Harry Bennett 太太了。

lines.en: Judge: How are you? How are you?
Judge: I think it’s time for the wedding to begin.
lines.cn: 我想是婚礼可以开始的时候了。

lines.en: Judge: All right, ladies and gentlemen. Please take your places. The wedding ceremony is about to begin.
Judge: OK, Jane. Start the music.

Judge: Dearly beloved, we are gathered here today to join this man and this woman in holy matrimony. Do either of you have any reason why you should not legally be joined in marriage? Is there anyone present who can show any just cause why these two people should not be legally joined in marriage? Then, Harry Bennett, do you take Susan Stewart to be your lawful, wedded wife?
lines.cn: 在座是否有人能提出任何正当理由，说明这两位不应合法结婚？

lines.en: Judge: And you, Susan Stewart, do you take Harry Bennett to be your lawful, wedded husband?
lines.cn: Susan Stewart，你愿意接受 Harry Bennett 作为你的合法丈夫吗？

lines.en: Judge: The rings, please. Richard  I have them, Harry.
Judge: By the power vested in me by the laws of the State of New York, I now pronounce you husband and wife. You may kiss the bride now, Harry.
lines.cn: 凭借纽约州法律赋予我的权力，我现在宣布你们结为夫妻。

lines.en: She went to a school-board meeting.
lines.cn: 她去参加学区教育委员会会议了。

lines.en: I don't know how she does it.
lines.cn: 我不知道她怎么办到的。

lines.en: There are lots of places to go,
lines.cn: 有很多地方要去，许多事情要做。
有很多地方要去，许多事情要做。

lines.en: She can't sit around and do nothing.
lines.cn: 她总不能闲坐着无所事事呀。

lines.en: I wish I had her energy.
lines.cn: 我希望我有她那样的精力。
嗯，我饿坏了。 唔……妈妈呢？
嗯，我饿坏了。 唔……妈妈呢？

lines.en: She went to a school-board meeting.
lines.cn: 她去参加学区教育委员会的会议。

lines.en: There's a note for you on the refrigerator.
lines.cn: 冰箱上有她留给你的字条。
吃过了，Mike 和我在小餐馆吃了汉堡。

lines.en: Mike and I had a hamburger at the diner. Mike
lines.cn: 吃过了，Mike 和我在小餐馆吃了汉堡。

lines.en: I came home a little while ago.

lines.cn: 爸爸，这星期你几乎每晚都工作到很晚。

lines.en: almost every night this week, Dad.
lines.cn: 爸爸，这星期你几乎每晚都工作到很晚。

lines.en: I don't have time to be exhausted.
lines.cn: 我没有时间去精疲力尽。

lines.en: You and Mom haven't had dinner together with us
lines.cn: 你和妈妈差不多整整一周没和我们一起吃晚饭了。
你和妈妈差不多整整一周没和我们一起吃晚饭了。
是啊，没能和家人一起吃晚饭，我也很过意不去，可我们的时间安排差得太多了。
是啊，没能和家人一起吃晚饭，我也很过意不去，可我们的时间安排差得太多了。

lines.en: about us not having dinner with the family,
lines.cn: 是啊，没能和家人一起吃晚饭，我也很过意不去，可我们的时间安排差得太多了。

lines.en: but our schedules are so different.
lines.cn: 是啊，没能和家人一起吃晚饭，我也很过意不去，可我们的时间安排差得太多了。

lines.en: Either I'm at the hospital doing paperwork,
lines.cn: 不是我在医院处理文书工作，就是妈妈在参加委员会的会议。

lines.en: or Mom is at a committee meeting.
lines.cn: 不是我在医院处理文书工作，就是妈妈在参加委员会的会议。

lines.en: I frankly don't know what to do about it.
lines.cn: 我真不知道该怎么解决。

lines.en: I'm worried about you and Mom.
You really have been working too hard.

lines.cn: 好啦，我想我已经吃够了三明治。

lines.en: I think I've had enough of that sandwich.
lines.cn: 好啦，我想我已经吃够了三明治。

lines.en: It's not good to eat before going to bed.

lines.cn: 好啦，我先去睡觉了，睡一个好觉。
好啦，我先去睡觉了，睡一个好觉。
好啦，我先去睡觉了，睡一个好觉。

lines.en: Haven't you finished balancing that checkbook?
lines.cn: 你还没有核对完支票簿账目？

lines.en: I'll be off to bed myself in a minute.
lines.cn: 我再过一会也要上床睡觉了。
我真的为他们担心，爷爷。
我真的为他们担心，爷爷。

lines.en: They hardly ever see each other.

lines.cn: 爸爸经常工作到很晚，妈妈又参加了那么多委员会。

lines.en: and Mom has all these committees she's on.
lines.cn: 爸爸经常工作到很晚，妈妈又参加了那么多委员会。

lines.en: What do you propose to do about it?

You ready for the next problem?

知道吗，我简直一个数字也看不进去了。

Oh, well, that would be very nice.
Just my friend Mike and a few kids from school.
lines.cn: 只有我的朋友 Mike 和学校几个家伙。

lines.en: I'm going to miss all of you.
You've been like a second family to me.
lines.cn: 你们就像我的第二个家一样。

lines.cn: 也许你可以到希腊来看我？

lines.cn: 你从高中毕业会不会感到很兴奋呢？

lines.cn: 当我刚到美国来的时候，是感到有点紧张。

lines.en: I'd never been away from home,
lines.cn: 我从没离开过家，也不知道会是什么样。

lines.en: and I didn't know what it would be like.
lines.cn: 我从没离开过家，也不知道会是什么样。

lines.en: But then I found out that people are the same everywhere
lines.cn: 但后来我发现，一旦彼此熟悉，就会知道哪里的人都一样。

lines.en: once you get to know them.
lines.cn: 但后来我发现，一旦彼此熟悉，就会知道哪里的人都一样。

lines.en: I'm glad I got to know you.
I'm glad I got to know you--and your family.
lines.cn: 我也很高兴能够认识你和你的一家人。

lines.en: Wouldn't it be nice if we could skip the examinations
lines.cn: 要是能跳过考试，直接参加毕业聚会，那该多好啊？

lines.en: and get right to the graduation party?
lines.cn: 要是能跳过考试，直接参加毕业聚会，那该多好啊？
那当然是很好。 但是现实不是如此。

lines.en: But that isn't the way it works.
lines.cn: 那当然是很好。 但是现实不是如此。
晚安 Stewart 太太。 谢谢你的晚餐。
晚安 Stewart 太太。 谢谢你的晚餐。

lines.en: Yes. The Molinas are waiting for me.
lines.cn: 不会。Molina 一家人在等着我呢。

lines.en: I'll pick you up on Saturday night, OK?
lines.cn: 我星期六晚上去接你，好吗？
我得赶紧走了。 晚安 Robbie。
我得赶紧走了。 晚安 Robbie。

lines.en: She's really a good friend, isn't she?
lines.cn: 她真是个好朋友，不是吗？

lines.en: You are going to miss her.
Am I going to miss her?
You are going to miss her!

lines.cn: 我会想念她，我的数学老师也会想念她。

lines.en: and my math teacher's going to miss her.
lines.cn: 我会想念她，我的数学老师也会想念她。

lines.en: Well, you can write to her.
You're sure Alexandra's going to be surprised?
lines.cn: 你确定 Alexandra 会很惊讶？

lines.cn: 她不知道这个派对是给她办的。

lines.cn: Millie，你带跳舞用的录音带了吗？
太好了 Alexandra 会喜欢！

lines.en: I can't wait to see her face when she walks in here tonight.
lines.cn: 我迫不及待想看到她走进来时脸上的表情。

lines.en: My mom's decorating it right now.
Robbie, there's a phone call for you. Robbie
No, let's wait till Robbie gets back from the airport.
lines.cn: 不要。我们等 Robbie 从机场回来吧。

lines.en: Did she say why she had to leave today?
lines.cn: 她说了她为什么今天非走不可吗？

lines.cn: 她告诉 Robbie，明天的航班取消了，所以她必须改乘今天较早的航班。

lines.en: so she had to take an earlier flight today.
lines.cn: 她告诉 Robbie，明天的航班取消了，所以她必须改乘今天较早的航班。

lines.en: Why is he blowing his horn like that?
lines.cn: 为什么他这样子按喇叭？

lines.en: Do you think we should take down the decorations?
lines.cn: 你觉得我们应当取掉这些装饰品吗？

lines.en: We should have done it sooner.
Especially when Alexandra gave me a surprise ...
lines.cn: 特别是 Alexandra 给了我一个惊喜……

lines.cn: 我从机场打电话给我父母。
我告诉他们，朋友们正在为我办聚会，他们就坚持让我留下来。

lines.en: my friends were giving me a party,
lines.cn: 我告诉他们，朋友们正在为我办聚会，他们就坚持让我留下来。
我告诉他们，朋友们正在为我办聚会，他们就坚持让我留下来。

lines.en: So now I'm taking a flight on Monday instead.
lines.cn: 所以我现在要改搭星期一的班机走。

lines.en: But how did you know the party was for you?
lines.cn: 但是你怎么知道派对是为你举办的呢？

lines.en: Well, Robbie told me when he gave me this.
lines.cn: 嗯，当 Robbie 送给我这个的时候，他告诉了我。

lines.en: Now we can really start the party!
lines.cn: 现在我们可以真正开始舞会了！

lines.en: I'd like to say something first.
I would just like to thank all of you,
lines.cn: 我想感谢你们所有人，我的朋友们，是你们让我的美国之行如此美好。
我想感谢你们所有人，我的朋友们，是你们让我的美国之行如此美好。

lines.en: who have made my stay in the United States so wonderful.
lines.cn: 我想感谢你们所有人，我的朋友们，是你们让我的美国之行如此美好。

lines.en: And to Robbie and the Stewart family
lines.cn: 也感谢 Robbie 和 Stewart 一家热情地接纳我。

lines.en: for opening their home to me.
lines.cn: 也感谢 Robbie 和 Stewart 一家热情地接纳我。

lines.en: And I also have a little surprise for you, Robbie.
lines.cn: 我也有一个小小的惊喜给你 Robbie。

lines.en: I think you might be amused.
lines.cn: 我想你可能会觉得有意思。

lines.en: I guess we were thinking the same thought.

lines.cn: 我知道我们想法相似，可这也太巧了！
我知道我们想法相似，可这也太巧了！

lines.en: Mrs. Stewart, may I have this dance? Stewart
lines.cn: Stewart 太太，我可以请你跳这支舞？

lines.en: Hot dogs. I love hot dogs.
There is nothing better than a hot dog in the country.
lines.cn: 在乡下，没有比吃热狗更棒的了。

lines.en: Cooked outdoors over an open fire.
I wish I had one now.
lines.cn: 我真希望现在就来一个。

lines.en: Do you remember when Daddy and I used to take you
lines.cn: 你还记得，爸爸和我以前常带你、Susan 和 Robbie 去 Jones 海滩吗？

lines.en: and Susan and Robbie to Jones Beach? Susan Roobbie
lines.cn: 你还记得，爸爸和我以前常带你、Susan 和 Robbie 去 Jones 海滩吗？

lines.en: We'd wait until dark and make a fire,
lines.cn: 我们等到天黑，生起火，再烤热狗。

lines.en: and we'd cook the hot dogs.
lines.cn: 我们等到天黑，生起火，再烤热狗。

lines.en: And, oh, does anybody want ketchup?
I might as well take it along.
And now to make sure we've got the hamburger patties.
lines.cn: 再来，务必要带汉堡碎肉饼。

lines.en: I have to remember to put them in the bag
lines.cn: 我得记住明早出发前把它们放进袋子里。
我得记住明早出发前把它们放进袋子里。
妈，真谢谢你放弃自己的休息时间，周末帮我们照顾 Max。

lines.en: we really appreciate your taking care of Max for the weekend
lines.cn: 妈，真谢谢你放弃自己的休息时间，周末帮我们照顾 Max。

lines.en: and giving up your free time.
lines.cn: 妈，真谢谢你放弃自己的休息时间，周末帮我们照顾 Max。

lines.en: Susan and Harry have a sitter for Michelle in the city, Susan
lines.cn: Susan 和 Harry 在城里给 Michelle 请了保姆，我就来照顾 Max。

lines.en: and I'm taking care of Max.
lines.cn: Susan 和 Harry 在城里给 Michelle 请了保姆，我就来照顾 Max。

lines.en: I am happy to do it for you.
lines.cn: 我很高兴为你们做这件事。

lines.en: I guess Max is asleep by now.
lines.cn: 我想 Max 现在已经睡觉了。

lines.en: I feel so bad for him.
It hurts so much when a baby gets his first teeth.
lines.cn: 小孩子长的第一颗牙齿时好痛哟。

lines.en: Well, he wakes up several times during the night,
lines.cn: 他夜里要醒好几次，疼得很厉害。

lines.en: and the pain is so bad.
lines.cn: 他夜里要醒好几次，疼得很厉害。

lines.en: I'm really concerned about going away for the weekend, Ellen,
lines.cn: Ellen，周末出门，把照顾 Max 的责任全交给你，我实在有些不放心。

lines.en: and leaving you with the full responsibility of taking care of Max.
lines.cn: Ellen，周末出门，把照顾 Max 的责任全交给你，我实在有些不放心。
特别是他现在在开始长牙。
我真希望他现在好一点。
别忘了，你公公是位儿科医生。

lines.en: We have a live-in doctor if there's a problem I can't handle.
lines.cn: 假如我遇到不能解决的问题，我们还有位驻家医生。

lines.en: We really don't have to be overly concerned.
lines.cn: 我们真的不需要过分担心。

lines.en: I'll go upstairs and stay with him until he falls asleep again.
lines.cn: 我上楼去陪他直到他又睡着。

lines.en: Try putting him across your lap on his stomach.
lines.cn: 试着让他趴在你的大腿上。

lines.cn: Susan 和 Harry 什么时候来接你们 Marilyn？

lines.cn: 他们明早六点过来，这样我们就能早点出发。

lines.en: so we can get an early start.
lines.cn: 他们明早六点过来，这样我们就能早点出发。

lines.en: And you'll have a full day in the country.
lines.cn: 你们就可以在乡下待一整天啦。

lines.en: Tomorrow night we'll be camping out in tents.
lines.cn: 明晚我们要在帐篷里露营。

lines.en: We'll be heading back late in the afternoon.
lines.cn: 我们会在黄昏时打道回府。

lines.en: You're going to have the time of your lives.
lines.cn: 你们将会玩得非常痛快。

lines.en: Camping out is such great fun.
lines.cn: 露营是件非常好玩的事。

lines.en: We'll have a great time camping out, I'm sure.
lines.cn: 我确定我们会在露营时玩得很开心。

lines.en: But I'm still a little worried about you, Ellen.
lines.cn: 不过我还是有点担心你，Ellen。

lines.en: It will be my great pleasure, Marilyn.
I think he'll sleep through the night now.
lines.cn: 我想他现在会睡到天亮。

lines.en: I hope he's good when we're away.
lines.cn: 我希望我们不在时，他很乖。

lines.cn: 现在，让我们检查一下露营旅行所需物品的清单吧。

lines.cn: 我们需要带一个手电筒。

lines.en: It's in the right-hand drawer, next to the bottle openers.
lines.cn: 在右边的抽屉就在开瓶器旁边。

lines.en: Do we have a bottle opener on the list, Marilyn?
lines.cn: 清单上有开瓶器吗 Marilyn？

lines.en: Is that one of the things Susan and Harry are bringing?
lines.cn: 那是 Susan 和 Harry 要带的东西之一吗？

lines.en: And we're bringing the ketchup, mustard, relish--all that stuff.
lines.cn: 我们还要带番茄酱、芥末酱、酸黄瓜调味酱——这些东西。

lines.en: Well, here's the bottle opener, and here's the flashlight.
lines.cn: 哦，这是开瓶器，这是手电筒。

lines.en: For when we build our campfire.
I can't build a fire by rubbing two pieces of wood together.
lines.cn: 我总不能靠着磨擦两片木柴来取火吧。

lines.en: And don't forget your camera and film, Richard.
lines.cn: 别忘了你的照相机和底片 Richard。

lines.en: And let's not forget our cassette player and some tapes.
lines.cn: 还别忘了带上我们的卡式录音机和一些录音带。

lines.en: Some music tapes and some blank tapes
lines.cn: 带些音乐带和空白带，这样就能录下我们对旅途的感想。

lines.en: so that we can record our thoughts about the trip.
lines.cn: 带些音乐带和空白带，这样就能录下我们对旅途的感想。

lines.en: The cassette player and the tapes.
To be away from the city on such a beautiful day
lines.cn: 在这么美好的一天远离城市，这就是我心目中的天堂！
在这么美好的一天远离城市，这就是我心目中的天堂！

lines.en: The grass. The trees. The fresh air.
I told you you'd like it. I've been doing this for years.
lines.cn: 我告诉过你会喜欢的。我多年来一直从事这项活动。

lines.en: You have the spirit of a teenager, Susan.
Wait till you see yourself jumping around.
lines.cn: 等着看你自己活蹦乱跳的样子吧。

lines.en: That's what I love about Susan.
lines.cn: 这就是我爱 Susan 的一点。
她是一个真正的 Stewart 家人。

lines.en: Help me get this stuff out of the car.
lines.cn: 帮我将这些东西拿下车子。

lines.en: Well, we'll put everything over there.
lines.cn: 嗯，我们把所有的东西都放在那边。

lines.cn: 我们就在那边树林边缘搭帐篷。

lines.en: Then we'll be able to make our fire there where it's safe.
lines.cn: 然后我们就可以在那儿找一个安全的地方生火了。

lines.cn: 哦，那是我们的桌子和长板凳。

lines.en: That's what makes this spot so good.
lines.cn: 那就是为什么这个地点这样好的道理。

lines.en: When you're out in the fresh air like this, it makes you hungry.
lines.cn: 来到户外，呼吸这样新鲜的空气，就容易饿。

lines.en: You guys are like three kids.
lines.cn: 你们三个就像孩子一样。

lines.en: Now that you mention it, I guess I am.
lines.cn: 你们一提到它，我想我也饿了。
我是说，大家都在谈吃的，一个人怎么可能不饿呢？

lines.en: how could a guy not be hungry with all this talk about eating?
lines.cn: 我是说，大家都在谈吃的，一个人怎么可能不饿呢？

lines.en: Where's the bag with the chicken salad sandwiches?
lines.cn: 装鸡肉沙拉三明治的袋子在哪儿？

lines.en: Right here, next to the ice packs. Here.
lines.cn: 就在这，在冰袋旁边。这儿。

lines.en: Put the tablecloth on the picnic table,
lines.cn: 你把桌布铺在野餐桌上，我来拿可乐和塑料杯。

lines.en: and I will bring the cola and the plastic cups.
lines.cn: 你把桌布铺在野餐桌上，我来拿可乐和塑料杯。

lines.en: Well, how do you like it so far?
lines.cn: 好了，到现在为止，你们感觉怎么样？
我从来没像这样轻松过。

lines.en: I wish we had brought Michelle, Harry.
lines.cn: 我真希望我们带了 Michelle 来 Harry。

lines.en: I wish we had brought Max.
lines.cn: 我也希望带上 Max 来。

lines.en: Marilyn, Susan, let's not begin to worry about Michelle and Max. Marilyn Susan
lines.cn: Marilyn，Susan，别又开始担心 Michelle 和 Max 了。

lines.en: We're having a good time, and they're in good hands.
lines.cn: 我们玩得很好，他们也得到很好的照顾。

lines.en: Are you having a good time, Susan?

lines.cn: 你还没有回答我的问题呢。

lines.en: I am having a good time, Harry.
I promise not to think about the city.
lines.cn: 我保证不再去想城里的事。

lines.en: Let's all just enjoy this wonderful place
lines.cn: 我们就好好享受这个美丽的地方和这么好的天气吧。
我们就好好享受这个美丽的地方和这么好的天气吧。

lines.en: It was such a great idea to spend the weekend this way.
lines.cn: 这样过周末的主意简直太棒了。

lines.en: I thought you'd all like it.
lines.cn: 我料想你们都会喜欢的。

lines.en: Listen to the sounds of the summer that surround us.
lines.cn: 仔细倾听环绕我们的夏夜声息。

lines.en: Away from the telephones and account books.

lines.cn: 这是我提高精神的方法。

lines.en: I always go back to the city in a wonderful state of mind.
lines.cn: 我再回到城市时，精神总是十分饱满。

lines.en: We've only been here for a day,
lines.cn: 我们才来一天，我就已经把所有工作上的烦恼忘得一干二净了。

lines.en: and I've completely forgotten about all my business problems.
lines.cn: 我们才来一天，我就已经把所有工作上的烦恼忘得一干二净了。

lines.en: The office seems so far away.
lines.cn: 办公室好像变得那么遥远。

lines.en: I'm glad you like it, Susan.
lines.cn: 我很高兴你喜欢它 Susan。

lines.en: We'll spend many more weekends like this.
lines.cn: 我们以后可以多度几次这样的周末。

lines.en: And next time we'll bring Michelle.
lines.cn: 下次我们带 Michelle 来。

lines.en: I wish she were here with us to enjoy the country.
lines.cn: 我真希望现在她就和我们在一起享受这乡村美景。

lines.en: And next time we'll bring Michelle.
lines.cn: 下次我们带上 Michelle 来。

lines.en: I can hardly keep my eyes open.
If only we could bottle the fresh air.
lines.cn: 要是我们用瓶子将新鲜空气装回去多好。
那样岂不是太美妙了吗？

lines.en: We could call it "Deep Sleep Country Air."
lines.cn: 我们可以称它为沉睡的乡村空气。

lines.cn: 光听着这些声音，我就快睁不开眼了。
光听着这些声音，我就快睁不开眼了。
它就像是一种特别的音乐。

lines.en: Too bad we can't bottle the sound.

lines.en: I'm so glad everyone is asleep.
I thought Max would be crying, and everybody would be awake.
lines.cn: 我还以为 Max 会哭个不停，让大家都睡不着。

lines.en: My mother knows all there is to know
lines.cn: 我向你保证，照顾宝宝的事，我妈妈样样都懂。

lines.en: about taking care of babies, I assure you.
lines.cn: 我向你保证，照顾宝宝的事，我妈妈样样都懂。

lines.en: Let's put some of this stuff away and then take off.
lines.cn: 我们把这些东西先收好一部分，然后就走吧。

lines.en: We've got a forty-minute drive into the city.
lines.cn: 我们还要开四十分钟车到城里去。
欢迎回家——我是真心盼着你们回来。

lines.en: and I do mean welcome home.
lines.cn: 欢迎回家——我是真心盼着你们回来。

lines.cn: 但他的牙疼让他不能入睡，可怜的小宝贝。
你们的周末过得怎么样？

lines.en: We had a great time, Mom.
The weather couldn't have been better.
Did you get a chance to get outside at all?
lines.cn: 你有机会到外面走走吗？
昨天下午，祖父帮我的忙。

lines.cn: 我去超市买了点东西，还额外在外面多待了半个小时。
